purpose: Add hard anti-regression guards for the 1943-10-01 synchronized restart: branch geography/ownership, Allied carrier losses, Japanese hull survival/capability, COMINT divergence and China-front state.

overrides.effective_rule: Default runtime restart is CHECKPOINT_1943-09-30T24_v001 at 1943-10-01T00:00. 1944 checkpoints are retained provisional and must not be selected implicitly.
Load and preserve BRANCH_INVARIANT_GUARD_1943-10-01_v001 before applying historical defaults or retained-provisional files. Conflicts are blockers, not silent substitutions.
At current restart Midway remains Japanese-held. The retained-provisional Sep-1943 recapture is not current history until re-adjudicated.
New Caledonia is Japanese military control of the main corridor/ports/airfields/external traffic under Vichy nominal sovereignty; do not map it to normal Allied ownership or simple annexation.

US branch losses Lexington/Yorktown/Enterprise/Hornet/Saratoga and British Indomitable/Formidable remain paid. Wasp survival and new Essex/CVL buildup are additive; historical named-carrier availability is not restored.

Do not apply historical ship/commander loss dates automatically. Use branch settlements; Shokaku/Zuikaku/Hiryu/Soryu are alive at Sep end, Hiei/Kirishima/Haruna have later branch activity, and Yamamoto survives 1943-04-18. Unresolved hulls remain unresolved.
Event resolution must load branch TECH v006 maturity and platform capability; never substitute historical median Japanese combat capability or back-port later systems.
Historical JN-25-like high-grade plaintext advantage is unavailable; residual COMINT/DF/recon remain. Japanese offensive COMINT is probabilistic, not omniscient.
Hanzhong is the settled Phase-II endpoint; Sichuan Phase III is HOLD. Burma transfers must be charged against post-Hanzhong consolidation/repair/storage/airfield-road pressure.

edit_protocol: v006 and earlier remain historical. v007 is additive and mandatory for the v023 current restart.
